title: A 4-panel candid photo collage captured
prompt:
A 4-panel candid photo collage captured by accident with a cheap 2005 pocket digital camera, forced flash off, golden hour in a quiet urban park. A young East Asian couple in casual outfits—he wears a rumpled white linen shirt and beige shorts, she wears a faded yellow sundress—caught in four playful moments, their faces 100% photorealistic, completely unaware of the camera.

Panel 1: He gives her a piggyback ride, both mid-laugh, her head thrown back, hair blowing across her face, his grin wide but tired. Motion blur softens his legs and her swinging feet.

Panel 2: He dips her backward playfully, her arm stretched out for balance, both laughing with eyes crinkled, his hand gripping her waist, her dress falling open. Motion blur softens her extended arm and her flowing hair.

Panel 3: They stand face to face, mid-high five, both laughing with open mouths, eyes squinted against the sun, hands mid-air. Motion blur softens their raised hands and the slight sway of their bodies.

Panel 4: He holds up his phone for a selfie, she leans in to kiss his cheek, his eyes wide with happy surprise, her eyes closed, lips pressed gently. Motion blur softens his phone hand and her leaning movement.

Behind them, warm golden sunlight filters through trees, creating soft bokeh, but the focus is slightly soft as if the camera missed perfect focus. Realistic skin texture, visible pores, sweat sheen on their brows, natural laughter lines, a small pimple on his chin, freckles on her nose, no beauty filter. Heavy grain, slight chromatic aberration, light leak in the top left corner. A stray cat tail curls around a park bench leg at the bottom right corner of each panel. Dutch angle 5°, 9:16
